brief:
A settler sustained injuries after being stabbed near Jericho, the Ma'an news agency reported. The attack occurred in the occupied West Bank region, though specific details about the identity of the assailant and the exact circumstances of the incident were not disclosed in initial reports.

The stabbing adds to a pattern of security incidents affecting the West Bank. Jericho, located in the Jordan Valley, has been the site of periodic clashes and confrontations in recent years. Authorities have not yet released further information about the condition of the wounded settler or any ongoing investigation into the attack.
title: Settler stabbed near Jericho
